questions.stem_text: How did scientists arrive at the theory of plate tectonics?

options.A: by determining the age of lava rising at ocean ridges
options.B: by determining the composition of limestone deposits
options.C: by determining the rate of weathering of mountain ranges
options.D: by determining the type of sedimentary rock formed on land

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - by determining the age of lava rising at ocean ridges

questions.stem_text:
A caterpillar eats an oak leaf. Which of the following best describes the energy transfer
in this situation?

options.A: Both the caterpillar and the leaf gain energy.
options.B: Energy is transferred from the leaf to the caterpillar.
options.C: Decomposers in the leaf obtain energy from the caterpillar.
options.D: The oak tree gains energy when the caterpillar eats the leaf.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Energy is transferred from the leaf to the caterpillar.
